_note: Accommodation any other employer owns: a percentage of the accommodation "salary" for the period occupied, by the city's 2011-census population, less the rent the employee paid (D-111). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(2) Table I Sl. 2(a) (p.1541), "(i) 10% of salary in cities having population exceeding forty lakhs as per 2011 census … (ii) 7.5% of salary in cities having population exceeding fifteen lakhs but not exceeding forty lakhs as per 2011 census …; and (iii) 5% of salary in other areas", each "in respect of the period during which the said accommodation was occupied … as reduced by the rent, if any, actually paid". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(1) Table I Sl. 2(a) as substituted by G.S.R. 615(E) (pp.4–5), the same percentages and bands. The band is the taxpayer's (PopulationBand): the Rules name no cities. The salary is SAL-SALARY-FOR-ACCOM less exempt allowances, apportioned to the period by days. The Cost Inflation Index cap for accommodation continued from an earlier year (r.15(2)(d); r.3(1) third proviso) is not built until the index is read: such accommodation is refused (D-111 C5a). Every regime.
